name: statflobot
description: StatfloBot — Desktop wrapper for the StatfloBot web app

scripts.build:mac: npm run build:mac:arm64 && npm run build:mac:x64
scripts.build:win: npm run build:ui && npm run clean:win && electron-builder --win
scripts.build: npm run build:mac && npm run build:win
scripts.publish:win: npm run build:ui && npm run clean:win && electron-builder --win --publish always
scripts.publish:all: npm run publish:mac && npm run publish:win
